structure_policy_rationale: The Quark logo is a simple, high-contrast geometric symbol. According to the theme rules (e.g., Alipay, Douban), simple geometric logos must be extruded into 3D ice sculptures while strictly maintaining their 2D silhouette. No semantic recomposition is needed as the shape itself is the identity.
preserve: Internal negative space forming the lowercase 'q' tail
Specific topology of the tail cutting the ring at bottom-right
Overall circular bounding box and geometric symmetry
must_preserve: The exact ratio of the outer ring thickness
The specific angle and curvature of the inner cut-out
The void/tunnel nature of the 'q' negative space (do not fill with ice)
recompose_allowed: Edge rounding (chamfered ice edges to mimic erosion)
Internal lighting effects (caustics, refraction, subsurface scattering)
restyle: Convert flat vector to volumetric 3D sculpture
Replace solid Electric Blue with translucent Cyan/Ice Blue material
Add glossy wet surface finish with specular highlights
Soften sharp geometric edges to rounded ice contours
decorate: Internal suspended air bubbles and micro-snowflakes
Soft diffuse contact shadow on white ground plane
Small melting water puddle or ice shards at base
forbid: Using original solid Royal/Electric Blue color for the main body
Filling the center 'q' hole with solid ice (must remain a void)
Adding unrelated elements like comets, planets, birds, or feathers
Flat 2D appearance or opaque plastic/metal materials
Dark or colored backgrounds (must be pure white/light grey)
Distorting the 'q' tail direction or position
generation_brief: 3D icon of Quark logo: a thick, translucent light-blue ice sculpture shaped like a ring with a specific 'q' tail cutout. Material is glossy wet ice with internal bubbles and snowflakes. Strong refraction and subsurface scattering. Centered on pure white background with soft contact shadow and small melting puddle at base. No solid colors, no outlines, high fidelity to original geometric silhouette.
color_application: Strictly replace original Electric Blue with theme's Translucent Cyan/Ice Blue (#A0D8EF approx). Use Pure White for specular highlights and Deep Blue/Grey for internal shadows/refraction. No brand color retention in the main body.
stroke_application: Eliminate all 2D strokes. Define form through 3D volume, lighting, and refractive edges. Edges must be smooth, rounded, and chamfered like eroded ice.
composition_application: Center the 3D 'Q' sculpture. Occupy 60-70% of canvas height. Ensure the object sits on a ground plane with a visible contact shadow and base details (puddle/shards) to anchor it vertically.
identity_application: Maintain strict geometric fidelity of the 'Q' shape and its negative space. Recognizability comes from the precise silhouette of the ring and tail, rendered in ice material rather than color.
fidelity_constraints: Subject must be translucent ice/crystal, not opaque plastic.
Color palette restricted to Ice Blue/White/Deep Blue shadows.
Original 'Q' silhouette must be instantly recognizable.
negative_constraints: No original brand blue solid fill.
